reader.requirement: At --std 85, a STRING statement changes only the character positions of identifier-3 into which a character was transferred (positions at and after the initial pointer and before the final pointer); every other position of identifier-3 (an elementary alphanumeric or numeric DISPLAY item, or a group, fixed or variable length) keeps the content it had before the statement, including when overflow stops the transfer at once or part way through.
reader.edition-search: grep of DialectLevel|CobolVersion|DialectBehaviors|ConstructDialectStatus|EditionContext|Edition.Year over StringEmitter.cs, CobolStringOps.cs, ReceivingStore.cs, PlaceRenderer.cs, OperandText.cs: no hit. StringUnstringBinder.cs uses ctx.Edition only as the diagnostic sink (Report/Error), never to switch. EcEmitter#EmitOverflow is gated by >>TURN enablement, which does not exist at 85, so it emits nothing there and at 2023 without >>TURN alike.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf02_03 S7 exercises an alphanumeric receiver with POINTER; not exercised are a group receiver with COMP-3/signed subordinates, a numeric DISPLAY receiver, a variable-length (ODO) receiver, and overflow before or during the transfer.

probes.expected: group with COMP-3 and signed subordinates: only positions 1-2 (then 3-4) change, the COMP-3 and signed items keep their values; PIC 9(6) 123456 -> 773456; S9(4) -1234 with '5' at position 1 -> -5234
ODO receiver of current size 6, pointer 6: position 6 written, overflow, positions 1-5 and the positions beyond the current size untouched
pointer 0 or negative: nothing changes; pointer 7 with 4 characters: positions 7-8 only; pointer 9: nothing; a sending item delimited at its first character: nothing changes

probes.printed: error COBOL1651: STRING INTO 'WS-R(3:2)': identifier-3 shall not be reference-modified
probes.expected: refused (§1985:VI.6.25.3 SR3), so no partial-receiver form reaches GR8

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.25.4 GR8  (║6.25.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR8

reader.notes: The emitter reads identifier-3's whole current image into one local, StringTransfer writes only the positions the pointer designates, and the image is stored back through the receiver's own writer, so untouched positions round-trip. Probed groups with COMP-3 and overpunched subordinates, numeric DISPLAY receivers, an ODO receiver and every overflow start: all keep the untouched positions. Edition-invariant path.

refuter.evidence: Read StringEmitter#EmitString/WriteImage: the whole receiver image is read, StringTransfer writes the pointer-designated positions, stored back via WriteGroupValue (group) or the character-image writer (numeric DISPLAY promoted to image storage, PB4089); no edition switch (grep of DialectLevel|DialectBehavior|Edition.|CobolVersion over StringEmitter.cs: none). Probes at --std 85 (refute-1985-114/rstr8-001, rstr8b-001): PIC 9(4) 'A' at pos 1 -> image [A234]; S9(4) trailing overpunch -1234, '7' at pos 4 -> [1237], '9' at pos 2 -> [193M] -1934; SIGN LEADING SEPARATE -123, 'X' at pos 1 -> [X123], 'Z' at pos 4 -> [-12Z]; group with COMP-3 subordinate partly overwritten (pos 3, pos 4) and group with BINARY subordinate (pos 3): untouched bytes compare equal to the saved image; group with JUSTIFIED RIGHT and numeric-edited subordinates: [x  AB 12.50Q] then [x  AB 17.50Q] (no re-justify, no re-edit); group with SYNC COMP slack bytes: bytes 2-8 kept, Y-N +0077. cite.py: OK  §1985:VI.6.25.4 GR8  the text is in GR8.
